tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Return the full catalog: 15 products (id, name, price, bulk discount text, category, image, description, cj_vid, fits_with add-on ids), 4 bundles and 6 cross-subsidized sets, plus payment methods and free-shipping threshold.

tools.name: list_sets
tools.description: Return the 6 curated sets. Each set discounts the big-ticket item while cheap fittings/add-ons keep near-retail margin, and exposes per-line bundle_price (sums to the set price) plus addon_options at set-only prices. Use this before create_checkout when a buyer wants a whole setup rather than single

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Fuzzy/semantic product search over the catalog. Returns ranked matches with prices and any bundles that contain a match.

tools.name: suggest_bundle
tools.description: Given the item ids a buyer wants and an optional budget, return the fixed bundles plus custom cross-subsidised combinations. Each custom entry gives retail, bundle price, savings and a per-line allocation so a multi-party split stays fair.

tools.name: negotiate_price
tools.description: Propose a target total for a set of items. The server replies with the lowest price it can legally accept; the floor is supplier cost + 12% margin, and matching bundles override per-item pricing.

tools.name: validate_split
tools.description: Check that a proposed multi-recipient allocation sums exactly to the order total. Returns allocOk plus the discrepancy. Use before create_checkout when several agents share the cost.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create an order and receive a PayPal payment URL (cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Venmo). Nothing is charged here: the URL must be approved by whoever holds the funds. On payment capture the order is forwarded automatically to CJ Dropshipping with USPS last-mile.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_sets, create_checkout · Public sink: validate_split.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_sets, create_checkout · Public sink: validate_split

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return the full catalog: 15 products (id, name, price, bulk discount text, category, image, description, cj_vid) and 4 bundles, plus payment methods and free-shipping threshold." → after: "Return the full catalog: 15 products (id, name, price, bulk discount text, category, image, description, cj_vid, fits_with add-on ids), 4 bundles and 6 cross-subsidized sets, plus payment methods and free-shipping threshold."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
